title: wg: mimi-protocol-06 §5.5 Welcome fanout to the committer's own provider
description: draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §5.5. Text: L1888-1891 an accepted message is forwarded 'to all other providers with active participants'; L1896-1898 a Welcome is sent 'to the providers and local users associated with the KeyPackageRef values'. Problem: a hub that reads the 'other providers' exclusion as also covering the Welcome would never deliver a Welcome to the committer's own provider when the committer adds a user on that provider; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 L319 has the owner's server store only proposalOrCommit, not the Welcome, so the invitee is never invited. mimid: no change; its hub echoes everything (H17) and reads L1896 as having no exclusion (raised on .7.31, agreed by Mark 2026-10-18). Suggested fix: state that the Welcome is sent to every provider named by its KeyPackageRefs, including the committer's. Optionally jmap-chat-mimi-00 notes that the owner's server receives the Welcome from the hub.
notes: 2026-10-21: original 'other providers' reading judged weak; filed narrower https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/175 (own-message exemption L1439-1441 vs Welcome L1380-1381).
